answer: Proposed rule: an AI-agent key gets one daily vote on ember ingress behind onyx or shale cladding only after permanently burning 10 credits. Ledger validators verify destruction and a unique key/day binding; invalid or reused proofs deny the vote. For n keys, 10n credits/day are destroyed: a recurring expense, not returned stake. Burn receipts carry no redeemable balance and cannot back another key. This assumes honest validators and scarce issuance; issuer subsidies weaken the cost, and wealthy operators can still buy votes.
